segments.text: Lesson 28
segments.translation: 第28课

segments.text: Patients and doctors
segments.translation: 患者和医生

segments.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
segments.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。

segments.text: What are patients looking for when they visit the doctor?
segments.translation: 患者看医生时都在寻找什么？

segments.text: This is a sceptical age,
segments.translation: 这是一个充满怀疑的时代，

segments.text: but although our faith in many of the things in which our forefathers fervently believed has weakened,
segments.translation: 尽管我们对我们祖先所热切相信的许多事物的信心已经减弱，

segments.text: our confidence in the curative properties of the bottle of medicine remains the same as theirs.
segments.translation: 我们对这瓶药的疗效的信心与他们一样。

segments.text: This modern faith in medicines is proved by the fact
segments.translation: 事实证明了现代人对药物的信仰

segments.text: that the annual drug bill of the Health Services is mounting to astronomical figures.
segments.translation: 卫生服务部门每年的药品费用正在上升到天文数字。

segments.text: and shows no signs at present of ceasing to rise.
segments.translation: 目前还没有显示出停止上升的迹象。

segments.text: The majority of the patients attending the medical out-patients departments of our hospitals feel that
segments.translation: 到本院医疗门诊就诊的大多数患者都认为

segments.text: they have not received adequate treatment unless they are able to carry home with them
segments.translation: 他们没有得到足够的治疗，除非他们能够带回家

segments.text: some tangible remedy in the shape of a bottle of medicine,
segments.translation: 一些有形的补救措施，如一瓶药物，

segments.text: a box of pills, or a small jar of ointment,
segments.translation: 一盒药片，或一小罐药膏，

segments.text: and the doctor in charge of the department is only too ready to provide them with these requirements.
segments.translation: 科室的负责医生非常乐意满足他们的这些要求。

segments.text: There is no quicker method of disposing of patients than by giving them what they are asking for,
segments.translation: 处理病人的方法没有比满足他们的要求更快的了，

segments.text: and since most medical men in the Health Services are overworked
segments.translation: 由于卫生服务部门的大多数医务人员都工作过度

segments.text: and have little time for offering time-consuming and little-appreciated advice on such subjects as diet,
segments.translation: 几乎没有时间就饮食等主题提供耗时且不被重视的建议，

segments.text: right living, and the need for abandoning bad habits etc.,
segments.translation: 正确的生活，以及放弃不良习惯的需要等，

segments.text: the bottle, the box, and the jar are almost always granted them.
segments.translation: 瓶子、盒子和罐子几乎总是被授予的。

segments.text: Nor is it only the ignorant and ill-educated person who has such faith in the bottle of medicine.
segments.translation: 并不是只有无知和没有受过教育的人才会对那瓶药抱有如此的信心。

segments.text: It is recounted of Thomas Carlyle that when he heard of the illness of his friend, Henry Taylor,
segments.translation: 据托马斯·卡莱尔回忆，当他听说他的朋友亨利·泰勒患病时，

segments.text: he went off immediately to visit him,
segments.translation: 他立即前去探望他，

segments.text: carrying with him in his pocket what remained a bottle of medicine formerly prescribed for an indisposition of Mrs. Carlyle's.
segments.translation: 他口袋里还揣着一瓶以前为卡莱尔夫人的身体不适开的药。

segments.text: Carlyle was entirely ignorant of what the bottle in his pocket contained,
segments.translation: 卡莱尔完全不知道他口袋里的瓶子里装的是什么，

segments.text: of the nature of the illness from which his friend was suffering,
segments.translation: 他的朋友所患疾病的性质，

segments.text: and of what had previously been wrong with his wife,
segments.translation: 以及他妻子之前的问题，

segments.text: but a medicine that had worked so well in one form of illness would surely be of equal benefit in another,
segments.translation: 但是一种药物在治疗一种疾病时效果很好，对于另一种疾病也同样有效，

segments.text: and comforted by the thought of the help he was bringing to his friend,
segments.translation: 想到他为朋友带来的帮助，他感到很安慰，

segments.text: he hastened to Henry Taylor's house.
segments.translation: 他赶紧赶到亨利·泰勒家。

segments.text: History does not relate whether his friend accepted his medical help, but in all probability he did.
segments.translation: 历史并没有记载他的朋友是否接受了他的医疗帮助，但他很可能接受了。

segments.text: The great advantage of taking medicine is that it makes no demands on the taker
segments.translation: 服药的最大好处是对服药者没有任何要求

segments.text: beyond that of putting up for a moment with a disgusting taste,
segments.translation: 除了暂时忍受恶心的味道之外，

segments.text: and that is what all patients demand of their doctors--to be cured at no inconvenience to themselves.
segments.translation: 这就是所有病人对医生的要求——在不给自己带来任何不便的情况下得到治愈。
